avis.titre: Best Primer I've Ever Used - And I've Tried Them All
avis.texte: After testing countless primers from drugstore basics to high-end splurges, I can confidently say this is the one. The Embryolisse Lait-Crème Concentré has become my holy grail makeup primer, and I'm not exaggerating when I say it outperforms everything else I've tried. What makes it stand out? It actually works. I've done my own side-by-side comparisons with different foundations and blushes, and the results are consistent: when I use this primer, my makeup looks fresh hours later. No creasing, no fading, no touch-ups needed. Yes, it's on the pricier side, but a little goes a long way. I only need about a nickel-sized amount for my entire face, so one tube lasts surprisingly long. When you factor in how well it performs, the cost per use is actually quite reasonable. If you're tired of primers that promise everything and deliver nothing, this is worth the investment. It's the rare product that lives up to the hype - and then some.
